rationale: With only 5 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced liquidation at market, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that gapped down ~7.6% and has been trading in a tight, directionless range ($41.51–$41.62) over the last five candles with no clear momentum. The ATR of $0.15 on 5-minute bars leaves almost no room for a meaningful risk/reward setup before the session ends, and the account is already down on the day with limited loss budget remaining.
